leadText:
----
 
 
Roaring All-Stars (Japanese: ガオガオ・オールスター Gaogao Ōrusutā) is the fourth Japanese ending theme of Pokémon the Series: XY. It debuted as an ending song in XY068, replacing DreamDream. It was also used as the ending for PK27.
plainText:
----
 
 
Roaring All-Stars (Japanese: ガオガオ・オールスター Gaogao Ōrusutā) is the fourth Japanese ending theme of Pokémon the Series: XY. It debuted as an ending song in XY068, replacing DreamDream. It was also used as the ending for PK27.

==Ending animation==
===Synopsis===
